sessionViewer.batchDeleteConfirmMessage: Permanently delete {count} selected sessions from their sources? This cannot be undone.
sessionViewer.confirmAppCache: Also empty the Antigravity App's browser cache.
sessionViewer.confirmCcSwitch: Also remove matching sync records from CC Switch and its backups (usage history is kept).
sessionViewer.confirmUsageMonitor: Also clean Usage Monitor records for sessions with no local copy left. Usage and cost history is kept.
sessionViewer.confirmFailed: Could not open the deletion confirmation: {error}
sessionViewer.deleteOtherSources: Other sources also have this session ID. To keep CC Switch from listing it again, search by ID under All sources and delete all matches.
sessionViewer.deleteWarnings: Some related data could not be cleaned:
sessionViewer.indexOnlyHint: Only index entries remain in this source (files are gone or in another source). Delete it to clear the leftover entry.
sessionViewer.noMessages: No messages available for this session
sessionViewer.noSessions: No Antigravity App or Antigravity CLI sessions found
sessionViewer.optionAppCacheHint: Empty the Antigravity App's Cache and Code Cache folders, which can hold session IDs. They are rebuilt automatically, so the next launch is a little slower.
sessionViewer.optionCcSwitchHint: Remove sync records from ~/.cc-switch and its backups for selected sessions and sessions with no trace left in their source. CC Switch can stay open; usage and cost history is kept.
sessionViewer.optionUsageMonitorHint: Clear titles and prompts for sessions with no local copy left, keeping token counts and costs. Removes the entry when the installed plugin has a matching independent usage record.
sessionViewer.ccSwitchVerificationPending: CC Switch sync records are awaiting verification. Quit CC Switch and any running Antigravity clients, then select Refresh.
sessionViewer.usageMonitorCleanupPending: Usage Monitor cache cleanup is pending. Quit standalone Usage Monitor and any running Antigravity clients, then select Refresh.
sessionViewer.recoveryPending: These stores have an interrupted cleanup that could not be recovered. If the Antigravity App or Antigravity CLI is running, quit both and refresh:
sessionViewer.selectToView: Select a session to view its messages
sessionViewer.title: Session management

pluginModal.title: Usage Monitor
pluginModal.desc: Track speed and cache hit rate per request, token usage and cost by model, and remaining 5-hour and weekly quotas by model pool.
pluginModal.quitFirst: Save your work, quit Antigravity with ⌘Q, and try again.
pluginModal.enable: Turn the plugin on under Customizations → Installed in Antigravity, then open it from the side panel.
pluginModal.foreign: The plugin folder is occupied by something else, so Anti-Power leaves it alone.
pluginModal.uninstallConfirm: Uninstall Usage Monitor? Settings and usage history in Antigravity's data directory will be kept.
pluginModal.savedFolder: Uninstalled. Your checkout or local plugin data was saved at {path}.
